{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Sort by response rate (descending)
response_rate_by_site = response_rate_by_site.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Output
response_rate_by_site"}
